parsed.rationale: Regular narrow-complex sinus rhythm at about 75-80 bpm with normal PR and QRS, normal R-wave progression, no pathological Q waves, and only mild concave-up J-point/ST elevation in V2-V5 with upright T waves (benign early repolarization pattern), which does not meet STEMI criteria.
